versions.name: Jack Nicol Cub Scout Camp

features.note: Individual showers with on-demand hot water near the campsites.
Meals are served family-style with a salad and breakfast bar.
Individual restrooms with flushing toilets near the campsites.
A horse program at the Wild West Frontier Fort.
A Rocky Mountain nature outpost covering forest, wildlife, and Leave No Trace.
Large canvas wall tents on wood platforms.
Cub World themed areas including a medieval castle, a frontier fort, and a lighthouse.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp (Cub World) at Ben Delatour Scout Ranch for Lions through Webelos and AOL, featuring medieval castle, frontier fort, and STEM themes.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
